about_the_game:
---

"Now Hiring: Daytime Security Staff for Apartment Complex"

Working hours: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Trial period: 10 days

There are three essential rules for security staff:

1. Always greet the residents.

2. Always have guests write their real name in the visitor log.

3. Never speak to the woman in white.

---

Overview

Pomegranate Housing Complex is a first-person horror adventure game where you work as a daytime security guard at a cursed apartment for 10 days.

The story branches depending on your interactions with residents and visitors—and whether you obey the rules.

Ten days of time-limited patrols

In-game time advances one hour every 3 real-world minutes.

Time stops during major events.

You’ll move between the guard room and the apartment building, carrying out tasks such as:

Guard Room:

  • Monitoring surveillance camera footage

  • Checking the visitor log and resident list

  • Greeting residents

  • Handling phone calls

Apartment Building:

  • Patrolling each floor and the rooftop

  • Responding to unusual occurrences

Breaking the rules will corrupt the ordinary

Several rules govern your job.

Breaking them increases your "Haunting Level."

If it rises too high, you'll lose control and face consequences.

But some events... can only be witnessed if the haunting is strong enough.

Uncover the hidden pasts of residents and guests

Residents and visitors follow fixed routines—appearing only at specific times and days.

But your involvement may cause their behavior to change.

Whether to face their hidden pain and trauma is entirely up to you.

Multiple routes, multiple endings

Your choices, rule adherence, and how you connect with others will shape the outcome.

Some scenes and endings will only occur under specific conditions.

Several endings exist—ranging from calm resolution to eerie revelations.

Why are you in a place like this?

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes:
Psychological horror elements
Depictions of death and unsettling behavior
Supernatural themes involving ghostly and unexplained events

Note: This game does not contain sexual content, graphic violence, or excessive gore.
There are no depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sex, drug abuse, or self-harm.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with OpenGL support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
